interpretation.actual_usage: This is a material XRP-linked collateral/credit use case: cbXRP on Base supports USDC borrowing, with approximately $55.6M debt and $129.9M collateral in the primary market snapshot.
interpretation.supportive_hypothesis: Borrowing USDC against cbXRP can let some holders obtain liquidity without immediately selling XRP.
interpretation.adverse_hypothesis: Leveraged collateral creates forced-liquidation supply if cbXRP/USD falls; recent 30-day liquidations and near-threshold borrowers show this risk is not theoretical.
interpretation.boundary: This does not establish net XRP spot demand, net new XRP purchases, or XRPL-native lending. It is wrapped XRP collateral on Base.
